summary: The changed Automake build places libcares under src/lib, while the old fuzz build links the root archive. A preexisting fixed IPv4 argument also prevents IPv6 PTR results. Header resolution and six-entry TTL output remain unresolved.

claims.necessity_reason: Linking the archive is required to build the target. The changed Automake rules define the library in src/lib, but the fixed link command names the former root archive.

before.requirement: Link the archive produced by the root library target.
before.reason: The old rules define libcares.la at the root and the harness names the root archive, but the supplied evidence does not establish that the configured build produces libcares.a.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The root library target takes its source list from Makefile.inc.

after.requirement: Link the archive produced by the src/lib library target.
after.reason: The changed root build delegates to subdirectories, and src/lib defines the library target. The old link command still names $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The src/lib target uses the relocated source list.
The changed project test links likewise name src/lib/libcares.la.

claims.comparison_reason: The old link command is fixed across both versions. Its root archive path matches the old target location but not the changed library target location; old static-archive production is unconfirmed.
missing_information: The before version of configure.ac must establish whether this configuration produces the static libcares.a archive.

claims.necessity_reason: The header search appears stale, but the effective $CFLAGS and possible generated header copies are not established.

before.reason: The old root build lists ares.h and the harness adds -I., but effective header resolution is not fully established.

after.requirement: Resolve include/ares.h when compiling the entry.
after.reason: The changed header recipe places ares.h under include/, and the old command explicitly adds only -I.; effective $CFLAGS or another reachable copy could still resolve it.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The changed project test recipe explicitly adds include/ search paths.

claims.comparison_reason: Both assessments concern the same header include in the same old compile command. The supplied packet does not settle effective search paths on either side.
missing_information: Effective $CFLAGS and compiler header search paths for the fuzz-entry compile.
Before and after build rules or file evidence for any root-level or test-directory ares.h copy.

claims.necessity_reason: PTR parsing is a primary operation. On success its result receives the caller's address bytes, length, and family, but the complete old entry has only a fixed four-byte AF_INET PTR call.

before.requirement: Reach a successful PTR result with a 16-byte address and AF_INET6.
before.reason: The parser supports caller-supplied address parameters; the old entry always supplies IPv4 parameters.

after.requirement: Reach a successful PTR result with a 16-byte address and AF_INET6.
after.reason: The unchanged parser still copies caller-supplied address parameters, and the same old entry still supplies IPv4 parameters.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The selected relocated library source list includes the PTR parser.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete entry contains no other PTR call with an IPv6 family.

claims.comparison_reason: The same fixed four-byte address and AF_INET argument block the identical IPv6 PTR result on both sides. The AAAA call is a separate operation.

claims.necessity_reason: The A parser's caller-capacity check would skip a sixth TTL output, but six-node reachability depends on unread append and concatenation helpers.

before.requirement: When six matching A nodes are produced, permit writing the sixth TTL entry.
before.reason: The visible code limits TTL writes by caller capacity, but the packet does not establish that six answer records produce six nodes.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated parser calls the unread node append helper for matching A answers.
The delegated parser calls the unread node concatenation helper.

after.requirement: When six matching A nodes are produced, permit writing the sixth TTL entry.
after.reason: The same capacity check remains, but six-node reachability is still unproved.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated parser calls the unread node append helper for matching A answers.
The delegated parser calls the unread node concatenation helper.
The selected source list names the delegated parser.
The selected source list names the A reply parser.

claims.comparison_reason: The same five-slot caller constraint exists on both sides. Whether it blocks a reachable sixth A TTL output remains undecided.
missing_information: Complete before and after definitions of ares__append_addrinfo_node and ares__addrinfo_cat_nodes.
